title: CIS Controls to CCI/NIST Mapping
description: Maps CIS Controls safeguard IDs to DISA CCI identifiers and NIST SP 800-53 controls. Used by MITRE SAF InSpec profiles to tag compliance controls with authoritative CCI/NIST references.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this mapping file was generated

source.description: Authority or method used to produce mappings (e.g., 'CIS Controls v8 + cyber.trackr.live/api')

entry_count.description: Total number of mapping entries (must match length of mappings array)

mappings.description: Array of CIS safeguard to CCI/NIST mappings

cis_id.description: CIS Controls safeguard ID (e.g., '5.4') or OCI-prefixed override (e.g., 'OCI-4.4')

cis_title.description: Human-readable title of the CIS safeguard or override

primary_cci.description: Primary CCI mapping used in InSpec control tags (null for NOT_MAPPED entries)

supporting_ccis.description: Additional CCIs that support the mapping (not used in control tags)

nist_control.description: NIST SP 800-53 control family or enhancement (e.g., 'AC-2', 'SC-7 (5)')

coverage_assessment.description: Narrative assessment of how well CCI/NIST covers the CIS safeguard

reasoning.description: Explanation of why this CCI maps to the CIS safeguard
